title: ProcessorAgreement
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — data processing agreement requirements under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 28 mandates that processing by a processor shall be governed by a contract or legal act setting out subject-matter, duration, nature, purpose, type of personal data, categories of data subjects, and obligations/rights of the controller. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 28.

contractInPlace.description: Whether a data processing agreement (contract or other legal act under EU/Member State law) is in place between controller and processor. Source: GDPR Art 28(3).

instructionsBound.description: Whether the processor processes personal data only on documented instructions from the controller, including with regard to transfers. Source: GDPR Art 28(3)(a).

confidentialityEnsured.description: Whether persons authorised to process personal data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under an appropriate statutory obligation of confidentiality. Source: GDPR Art 28(3)(b).

securityMeasuresImplemented.description: Whether the processor takes all measures required pursuant to Article 32 (security of processing). Source: GDPR Art 28(3)(c).

subProcessorAuthorized.description: Whether the processor has obtained prior specific or general written authorisation from the controller before engaging another processor. Source: GDPR Art 28(2).

subProcessorContractMirrored.description: Whether the same data protection obligations as set out in the controller-processor contract are imposed on any sub-processor by way of a contract. Source: GDPR Art 28(4).

controllerAssistanceProvided.description: Whether the processor assists the controller in responding to data subject requests (Art 28(3)(e)), ensuring compliance with Art 32-36 obligations (Art 28(3)(f)), and providing all information necessary to demonstrate compliance (Art 28(3)(h)). Source: GDPR Art 28(3)(e)-(f)(h).

dataDeletedOrReturned.description: Whether the processor deletes or returns all personal data to the controller after the end of the provision of services, and deletes existing copies unless EU/Member State law requires storage. Source: GDPR Art 28(3)(g).

auditRightsGranted.description: Whether the processor makes available to the controller all information necessary to demonstrate compliance and allows for and contributes to audits and inspections. Source: GDPR Art 28(3)(h).

contractContentsComplete.description: Whether the contract contains all elements required by Art 28(3)(a)-(h): instructions binding, confidentiality, security measures, sub-processor conditions, data subject request assistance, compliance assistance, data deletion/return, audit rights.

contractInWriting.description: Whether the contract or legal act is in writing, including in electronic form. Source: GDPR Art 28(9).
